_about: English for every player-visible Portuguese string of Penumbra e o Castelo das Sombras (2010), read by game/render/Localization. Keys are the original's text in UTF-8 (the game holds it as cp1252 bytes; the loader converts). Line breaks are kept where the original has them, and lines are kept about as long as the Portuguese, because every text is drawn at a fixed place (menu panel at x=652, 391 px wide; help messages at (10,70) in Arial 30; lore signs in Arial Narrow 16). Lookup trims the text's leading and trailing whitespace and puts it back around the English, so keys carry none. Keys starting with '_' are notes. Sources: extracted/app/*.as (DrawText, shadowText, showData, addMessage, Switch labels), data.enml (global.story01-04, soldados, fun, comboTip, bridge, annoying, flyingWall, portalToCastle, warning, nights, wisdom, arena1-6), scenes/*.esc (help signs' 'message', arena thumbnails' 'title'). Not listed: the TESTING-only debug overlays ('FPS: ', 'NPCs: ', controlCharacters.as:206, setupScene.as:329), which the shipped build never compiled.

strings.•Controles\n Movimento: < e >\n Pulo: ^:
•Controls
 Move: < and >
 Jump: ^ or CTRL (joystick 3)
 Attack/sword: S (joystick 4)
 Attack/fire: D (joystick 2)
 Cast light: SPACE (joystick 1)

 Detect joysticks: hold J

•2 players:
 If a joystick is plugged in,
 the main character gains
 the power to summon a
 creature that can be controlled
 by the 2nd player.

 To summon the creature, just
 press START on the 2nd controller.

 The summoning spell costs 50 mana
 and one life, but it lets 2
 players fight side by side.

 Only player 1 can pick up
 checkpoints and finish a level.

strings.Penumbra não é um bom lugar\npara se viv:
Penumbra is no place to
make a life. When the mist
lifts, the storm rolls in.

Ages ago, a mighty sorcerer
seized control of the
gloomy land called Penumbra,
naming himself king of this world.

For centuries, the Order of the
Wizards of Penumbra has sought
to overthrow the tyrant.

After countless years training
in the arts of magic and combat,
you have been chosen by the Order
to go to the Castle of Shadows
of Penumbra and slay the king,
ending a reign that has lasted
for years.

to the Castle of Shadows
without drawing much attention

These bridges are in need

strings.Como será que essas paredes flutuam?: How do these walls float, I wonder?

This portal should take us to
the castle garden...
strings.No escuro? sim.\nSozinho? Jamais!:
In the dark? Yes.
Alone? Never!
strings.Poupe mana antes de entrar na sala do re: Save mana before entering the king's hall
strings.Este grande monumento localiza-se\nna en:
This great monument stands
at the main entrance of the Castle
of Shadows.
strings.As instalações subterrâneas de penumbra\:
The underground halls of Penumbra
hide many a gloomy beauty.
The lava pools are one example.
strings.A fortaleza do Castelo das Sombras\nposs:
The fortress of the Castle of Shadows
is riddled with traps. Watch closely
where you step.
strings.Se Penumbra fosse uma terra mais\namigáv:
If Penumbra were a friendlier
land, the garden of the Castle of
Shadows might be lush with green
and flowers. That is not the case.
strings.Pouco se sabe sobre este misterioso\nloc:
Little is known of this mysterious
place. Some say it was raised
as a tribute to the gods
who dwell in other worlds.
The weather in Penumbra is most
pleasant. When the mist lifts,
the storm comes. Then night falls.

images._about: Images with Portuguese baked into their pixels, keyed by the path the original loads (a normal or gloss map is its own entry). 'en' is the English variant's path relative to this file's folder, generated by tools/art/make_english_art.py from the original (same size, mode and layout, so every rectangle the scripts compute still fits); empty means the original is drawn in both languages. Localization::ImageVariant returns it when it exists. 'labels' is what the variant says. entities/gameover.png already reads 'Game Over'.

entities/menu_buttons.png._note: menu.esc's buttons (buttons.ent), 512x512, one label per 512x64 frame; its normal map and gloss map carry the same letters and have their own entries below

entities/normalmaps/menu_nm_buttons.png._note: buttons.ent's <Normal>: the English labels embossed the way the original's are (render/Lighting resolves it)

entities/menu_buttons_gloss.png._note: buttons.ent's <Gloss>: the English label mask, so the highlight (render/Lighting resolves it) does not show the Portuguese letters

entities/gamelogo.png._note: the title on the menu (gamelogo.ent). 'Penumbra' is the original's pixels; the subtitle's hand-cut uncial has no installed match, so the English is Matura MT Script Capitals at the original's x-height and span - a judgement call: empty 'en' to keep the Portuguese subtitle

interface/arrow_button.png._note: the video options screen's back button (videoModes.as:81, DrawSprite); 'Back' in Matura MT Script Capitals, as the logo

interface/input_options1.png._note: g_controls' first option: keyboard for player 1, joystick for player 2 (switch.as:98, DrawSprite)

interface/input_options2.png._note: g_controls' second option: a joystick for each player
